summary: Frontend testing completed for multiple bug fixes. All 10 features verified and working correctly: Dashboard Monthly Cash Flow moved to top, Income/Expense clickable navigation, Investment form frequency dropdown for all categories (except SGB/SWP), Fixed/Variable expenses pages visible with light theme styling, Credit Card form honeycomb background, Job/Business Income back button navigation to /my-income.

issues: Header text color is dark gray (rgb(31, 41, 55)) instead of white due to light theme CSS override in index.css (.honeycomb-bg h1 rule). Text is still VISIBLE and readable on the light/amber gradient backgrounds. This appears intentional for light theme consistency.

dashboard_monthly_cashflow_position.details: Monthly Cash Flow card (income-expense-card) is at position 0 in main content area, appearing ABOVE Assets/Investments cards

dashboard_income_clickable.details: Income section in Monthly Cash Flow navigates to /my-income when clicked

dashboard_expense_clickable.details: Expense section in Monthly Cash Flow navigates to /my-expenses when clicked

investment_form_frequency_fd.details: Fixed Deposit category shows Investment Frequency dropdown with options: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Other

investment_form_frequency_all_categories.details: Frequency dropdown visible for: Fixed Deposit, Recurring Deposit, Stocks, Mutual Fund, ETF, Crypto. Correctly hidden for: SGB, SWP

fixed_expenses_visibility.details: Fixed Expenses page (/expenses/fixed) loads correctly with visible header text (dark text on light gradient background due to light theme)

variable_expenses_visibility.details: Variable Expenses page (/expenses/variable) loads correctly with visible header text (dark text on amber gradient background due to light theme)

credit_card_form_honeycomb.details: Credit Card Form has honeycomb-bg class applied, showing honeycomb pattern background

job_income_back_button.details: Job Income form back button navigates to /my-income (not /my-job)

business_income_back_button.details: Business Income form back button navigates to /my-income (not /my-business)

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed/Variable expenses header text color is overridden by CSS rule in index.css line 116-120 (.honeycomb-bg h1 rule forces text-primary color). The text is still visible/readable, but if white text on gradient background was intended, the CSS override would need adjustment.
Routes for Fixed/Variable Expenses are /expenses/fixed and /expenses/variable (not /fixed-expenses and /variable-expenses)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 bug fixes verified and working. Dashboard layout restructured with Monthly Cash Flow first. Investment form shows frequency dropdown for all categories except SGB and SWP. Fixed/Variable expenses pages accessible via /expenses/fixed and /expenses/variable routes. Light theme CSS override in index.css affects all .honeycomb-bg pages including expense pages - this converts header text to dark color for consistency. Job/Business Income back buttons correctly navigate to /my-income.
